date.as_written: smvt vedābhrāṅkabhūmimite pau[[ṣe]] māsi śukla[[pa]]kṣe trayodaśyāṃ somo

notes: The chronogram 'vedābhrāṅkabhūmi' represents veda (4), abhra (0), aṅka (9), bhūmi (1) = VS 1904. The cataloguer identifies Jagaddhara Paṃta as scribe, but the text states: '...jagddharapaṃtebhyo kurmāṃcalasthebhyo... svahastena saṃpūrṇīkṛtya... samarpitā' (dedicated/given to Jagaddhara Paṃta of Kurmācala, having been completed with one's own hand).
